short_scenes.caption: Snow. Everywhere.
short_scenes.narration: The winters grew longer. Rivers froze. The animals vanished south.

short_scenes.caption: Nana's warning.
short_scenes.narration: Nana gathered the tribes. If we stay, we die, she said. We must walk to where the sun is warm.

short_scenes.caption: The great journey begins.
short_scenes.narration: So they walked. Hundreds of people, into the unknown, with only fire and each other.

short_scenes.caption: The ground began to shake.
short_scenes.narration: Then, on the fifth day, the ground began to shake. Something enormous was coming.

short_scenes.caption: What is shaking the ground? Comment your guess!
short_scenes.narration: What is shaking the ground? Comment your guess below. Follow so you don't miss the next part.
